line: Nine of Wands: Crowley's title, planetary attribution and place on the Tree, with his account of the card.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: Title and planet, as the chapter gives them (pdf 180, 194).

quotes.quote: The Nine of Wands is called Strength
This card is also governed by the Moon in Sagittarius

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: The card is ruled by the Moon and Yesod (pdf 180); Yesod is saved by the direct ray from Tiphareth (pdf 180).

quotes.quote: It is ruled by the Moon and Yesod.
What saves Yesod is the direct ray from Tiphareth;

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: His description of the Nine, not a divinatory reading.

quotes.quote: The Nine represents always the fullest development of the Force
